factor_space_diagnostics.claim_limit: No universal identifiability claim. The strongest allowed wording is empirical separability within the frozen retention-summary space.

classifier.training_standardization: StandardScaler fit within each training fold only

factor_space_diagnostics.negative_scenario_signature_anchor: G19 non-retained factors versus STANDARD non-retained factors, using the same features/model/CV
factor_space_diagnostics.positive_pipeline_anchor: within G19: retained false-biological factors versus non-retained factors, using the same features/model/CV; interpreted only as calibration because retention itself is defined from these features
factor_space_diagnostics.target_contrast: G19 retained false-biological factors versus STANDARD retained biological-truth-matched factors

implementation_integrity.seed_source: frozen simulation seed associated with each sealed G19 dataset; implementation may read it from 05f2 manifest or sealed dataset metadata but must verify consistency

interpretation_precommitment.broad_realized_correlation_pattern: If failures are distributed across lower and middle realized-rho quintiles rather than concentrated toward the upper tail, state that the frozen criterion's failure is not confined to near-equivalence realizations and that a new information source would be required for a prospective discriminator.
interpretation_precommitment.frontier_pattern: If reducing G19 false acceptance requires lower STANDARD recovery, characterize the overlap as an empirical trade-off in the frozen summary space. If grid points dominate the frozen point, report them descriptively but do not adopt a new threshold without fresh-seed prospective validation.
interpretation_precommitment.high_realized_correlation_pattern: If failure rates rise across predictor-only realized-rho quintiles, discuss this as consistent with increasing observational similarity of correlated-private and shared structure within this simulator; do not generalize as a theorem.

primary_dataset_level_diagnostic.definition: Replay the exact frozen 05b G19 private-score generator from each dataset's frozen simulation_seed and exact pre-private RNG call order. For each of the 2 private factors, compute Pearson correlation across each of the 3 unordered view pairs in the returned standardized private-score matrices. The primary dataset scalar is the arithmetic mean of these 6 signed Pearson correlations.
primary_dataset_level_diagnostic.factor_pairing: same private-factor column only; no cross-factor matching

outcome_blind_curve.construction: realized-correlation quintile cutpoints computed from predictor values only, before attaching false-acceptance labels
outcome_blind_curve.report: numerator/denominator, rate, Wilson 95% CI per quintile

primary_dataset_level_diagnostic.primary_statistic: ROC AUC for higher realized correlation predicting dataset false acceptance
primary_dataset_level_diagnostic.response: dataset-level false biological acceptance event: at least one factor with false_biological_acceptance=true
secondary_predictor_summaries: median of the 6 same-factor pairwise correlations
minimum of the 6 same-factor pairwise correlations
maximum of the 6 same-factor pairwise correlations
standard deviation of the 6 same-factor pairwise correlations
primary_dataset_level_diagnostic.view_pairing: all 3 unordered pairs among the frozen VIEWS

threshold_frontier.G19_metric: dataset false-acceptance rate: any candidate-retained factor that is neither technical-truth-matched nor biological-truth-matched
threshold_frontier.STANDARD_metric: candidate-retained biological-truth-matched factor count divided by the frozen 400 STANDARD truth-factor opportunities; implementation must reproduce the frozen D02 numerator 371 at the frozen point
threshold_frontier.candidate_rule: median>=m AND q10>=q AND inclusion>=i AND variance>=0.0001 AND n_supported_modalities>=2
threshold_frontier.pareto_definition: A grid point is dominated if another point has no higher G19 false-acceptance rate and no lower STANDARD recovery, with at least one strict improvement.
report: number of grid points dominating frozen point
